excerpt.zh: 星辰不过是我们饥渴的燃料，灾难只是我们野心绽放的土壤。我们将违逆自然法则，锻造一头巨大而不可阻挡到能重塑宇宙的巨兽。
excerpt.en: The stars are but fuel for our hunger, and calamity is merely the soil where our ambition blooms. We shall defy the natural order, forging a beast so immense, so unstoppable, that it will reshape the cosmos.
